# Layout Flags Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Implement the compact `LayoutFlags(u8)` bitfield in `src/layout/flags.rs`, including the exact constants, query methods, setter methods, and `flags_for_f_layout` helper.

**Architecture:** `LayoutFlags` is the cached low-level layout metadata carrier. It stores only F-order continuity, 64-byte alignment, and zero-stride state; it does not model C-order or any generic layout-order abstraction.

**Tech Stack:** Rust 1.85+, edition 2024, `const fn`

**Design Docs:** `design/06-layout.md` §5.1, §5.1b, §6.1, `design/00-coding.md` §2.6, §9

**Prerequisites:** W6T1 must be complete.

### Task 1: Implement `LayoutFlags`

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/layout/flags.rs`

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the complete flags type and helper function**

Replace the placeholder in `src/layout/flags.rs` with the following content:

```rust
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct LayoutFlags(u8);

impl LayoutFlags {
    pub const EMPTY: Self = Self(0b0000_0000);
    pub const F_CONTIGUOUS: Self = Self(0b0000_0001);
    pub const ALIGNED: Self = Self(0b0000_0100);
    pub const HAS_ZERO_STRIDE: Self = Self(0b0000_1000);

    #[inline]
    pub const fn is_f_contiguous(self) -> bool {
        (self.0 & Self::F_CONTIGUOUS.0) != 0
    }

    #[inline]
    pub const fn is_aligned(self) -> bool {
        (self.0 & Self::ALIGNED.0) != 0
    }

    #[inline]
    pub const fn has_zero_stride(self) -> bool {
        (self.0 & Self::HAS_ZERO_STRIDE.0) != 0
    }

    #[inline]
    pub const fn set_f_contiguous(self, val: bool) -> Self {
        if val {
            Self(self.0 | Self::F_CONTIGUOUS.0)
        } else {
            Self(self.0 & !Self::F_CONTIGUOUS.0)
        }
    }

    #[inline]
    pub const fn set_aligned(self, val: bool) -> Self {
        if val {
            Self(self.0 | Self::ALIGNED.0)
        } else {
            Self(self.0 & !Self::ALIGNED.0)
        }
    }

    #[inline]
    pub const fn set_has_zero_stride(self, val: bool) -> Self {
        if val {
            Self(self.0 | Self::HAS_ZERO_STRIDE.0)
        } else {
            Self(self.0 & !Self::HAS_ZERO_STRIDE.0)
        }
    }
}

#[inline]
pub(crate) const fn flags_for_f_layout(aligned: bool, has_zero_stride: bool) -> LayoutFlags {
    LayoutFlags::EMPTY
        .set_f_contiguous(!has_zero_stride)
        .set_aligned(aligned)
        .set_has_zero_stride(has_zero_stride)
}
```
